subject: Emotions
title: Flow States
description: A fast breakdown of Flow States for builders.

hook.text: A surgeon operates for six hours and feels like twenty minutes passed. Time vanished. Csikszentmihalyi called it flow.

buildup.text: Flow happens when skill meets challenge perfectly. Too easy is boredom. Too hard is anxiety. The sweet spot is joy.

discovery.text: In flow, the prefrontal cortex quiets down—the inner critic shuts off. You stop judging and just do.

twist.text: Flow is retrospectively joyful—not during it. People in flow don't feel happy. They feel nothing but the task.

climax.text: The most joyful lives aren't the most pleasurable. They're the ones with the most flow—deep engagement beats comfort.

punchline.text: The deepest joy happens when you forget yourself.

quiz.question: What happens to the prefrontal cortex during flow?
